answer: A farm of 327 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in karst, queued in pearl, and echo publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 60 identities per epoch. A farm of 1048 identities would post 4925 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
